# THE 1ˢᵗ SCI-FI NARRATIVE FILM to be released in the NEW IMMERSIVE CINEMA FORMAT (8K 180VR-3D)
# Chapter I in a series of films (upcoming Chapter Trailer Included)

.

**The Talent Stealer™ is an Award-Winning & Spectacular Sci-Fi Action-Thriller that achieves NEW LEVELS of Entertainment and Sophistication in VR Filmmaking - with an incredible concept & story in the vein of The Matrix, Inception, X-Men and Nikita:**

![{"height":242,"type":"image","width":1280}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75429290_832273112164063_748836112433419211_n.png?_nc_cat=103&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=MjRyv4H_5RwQ7kNvgG4p96z&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAMgSEhkDNzbANwcu-aknf4n_YAP4TnAM7jR2XqE_-94A&oe=675AB60F)

.

At a secret facility called The Maxstein Institute, a group of students are controlled & trained to master their special mind, memory & skill-stealing abilities by a shadowy organization with morally ambiguous goals. One student is singled out for her extraordinary power, and finds herself fighting for her freedom and sanity from those that wish to control her

**Starring performers Breanna Watkins (The Predator, Sonic) and Jared Payne (The Last of Us S2)**

.
![{"height":524,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75210397_568206855684714_6818633671153681412_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=GJagI11jRncQ7kNvgHhhKLf&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBGEx3KKMg7yz24Xno7QmHHew5Ap26JRVNX_a7t9xNQ5g&oe=675AD83D)
![{"height":1063,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38984459_428947986916423_4436878377542760621_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=qqYXLuHXbvMQ7kNvgGXWMfH&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDlm6FmlFDDSvznV5n49rffe7wOmstL_NV3ZrnwDsNTqg&oe=675AC1D0)






- Specially engineered to combine elements of 2D Cinema with the new 3D-180 Immersive Video format, you can truly feel like you have "stepped inside" a Hollywood movie for the **VERY FIRST TIME** - experiencing Cinema standards of lighting, VFX and editing for a complex narrative story flow and "little to no" motion sickness

![{"height":876,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974611_594527466344720_2836532959529751053_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=MN20hKPE8V4Q7kNvgEZd7Wp&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC3UGs-UhQxOp5QkrfVzNAHqmiPcyhSe-6ME4MdwXkdVw&oe=675ABF3C)




*SPATIAL AUDIO upgrade soon
*Film contains scenes with flashing lights, not suitable for photosensitive viewers

The Talent Stealer™ copyright 2022 (30mins)


.
